name: readable-contracts-and-tests
goal: People understand contracts and recorded input to output without reading JSON; exact data, errors, and evidence gaps stay available

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Default contracts expose declared descriptions. Tests present named fields, typed values, lists and flat record tables; exact recordings remain available.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Five focused presenter tests failed before implementation: labels, tables, typed empty values and bounded previews were absent.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Generated shared RecordedValue using Harness. Contracts expose descriptions; compact typed previews preserve raw evidence, parser decisions, errors, and history.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Five original presenter regressions now pass. All fourteen report browser tests and twelve desktop evidence/browser cases passed, including typed values and separate current/commit views.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Normal repository check stages passed in resumed runs. All 172 desktop browser checks, 14 report browser checks, 13 shared-import guards and 12 evidence-wiring checks pass. Fresh desktop, tablet and mobile captures inspected. Exact source verification follows separately.
